message: We have six engineering professors from Herat University--two women and four men--who are going to be on campus for the month of February observing and working with us who teach professional writing and engineering.  I have to admit that I can't wait for the interactions because I know they expect to be the learners, but I'm expecting us to learn a whole lot, too.  I think the best part will come from things we cannot imagine right now, and the complications you describe in this post are why.
